evidence.title: Remove Background from Image for Free – remove.bg

name: remove.bg
summary: Automatic background remover: upload a photo and get a transparent or solid-color background in seconds.
description: Web tool that removes image backgrounds automatically, with editing for white or transparent backgrounds, a Magic Brush and use-case pages for e-commerce, marketing, car dealerships and enterprise. A paid API and higher-resolution downloads cover HD photos and bulk workflows.
contains: automatic background removal from a photo
white, transparent and other background colors
background removal API with docs, libraries and OAuth
free to use; paid plans unlock HD photos and API calls
